sections.title: Zarrin Namaye Caspian Manufacturing & Operations
sections.subtitle: The exclusive Hisense representative in Iran
body: Every process—forecasting, inbound logistics, showroom planning, and training—is benchmarked against the same KPIs used by Hisense Global. This guarantees that Iranian customers receive original products, updated firmware, and certified accessories.

Our centralized operation orchestrates over 1,300 certified sales and service points. Installations, spare-part traceability, and quality audits are coordinated through a unified CRM that mirrors Hisense’s international service playbook.
Our smart TV portfolio extends the Hisense experience with localized content partnerships and premium after-sales programs designed for family entertainment in Iran.

sections.title: Hisense Global
sections.subtitle: Innovation across consumer electronics, HVAC, medical devices, and IT
body: Hisense ranks among the world’s most trusted appliance and display brands, with 29 industrial parks and 26 R&D centers powering continuous innovation in TVs, HVAC, refrigeration, and medical imaging.
The global group’s investments in AI picture processing, high-efficiency compressors, and IoT platforms are shared with Hisense Iran to accelerate market-ready solutions.

Joint programs with Zarrin Namaye Caspian deliver market intelligence back to the global product teams, ensuring that Iran’s requirements influence future generations of displays and climate solutions.

sections.title: Flagship Hisense Iran Showroom
sections.subtitle: Experience the portfolio in person
body: Located on Shariati Street in Tehran, the flagship showroom recreates the immersive style of global.hisense.com experiences with large-format storytelling, interactive demo walls, and project consultation lounges.
Customers can compare premium ULED TVs, laser displays, smart refrigerators, washers, and RAC/CAC systems under one roof.
Specialized consultants guide households, architects, hospitality groups, and government tenders with financing, maintenance plans, and on-site training.
